text:
Priya: Heads-up — need an urgent MDF rebalance for Q3. Marketplace co-marketing promo got pushed out by the cloud marketplace team and several SI onboarding dates slid. Proposing to shift $120,000 from marketplace paid activation into SI enablement + partner training. Can Partner Council sign off by EOD Fri? @Marco can you confirm runway? :eyes:

Marco: We currently have $200k allocated in the Q3 MDF pool. If we move $120k that leaves $80k for other plays. Need to check outstanding commitments (two partner POs pending).

Sam: From finance: moving $120k is doable if we trim contingency. I need a spend breakdown and partner IDs to produce updated P&L.

Ava: Proposed reallocation breakdown (quick):
```
- SI enablement: $70,000
- Training & certs: $25,000
- MDF admin / contingency: $25,000
```
(Adjustable if marketing chips in.)

Lena: Marketing can reprioritize $20k of creative/ads into partner enablement if that helps. We could reduce marketplace paid ads to $30k for the promo window.

MDF Bot: New request logged: ticket #MDF-8123 — "Q3 MDF rebalance request". Status: pending approval. Link: https://mdf.internal/tickets/MDF-8123

Priya: Also recommending a temporary scorecard tweak to reflect the shift: reduce marketplace tier multiplier and bump SI engagement multiplier for Q3 only. Draft below:
```
scorecard_changes = {
  "marketplace_multiplier": "1.0",  # from 1.2
  "si_multiplier": "1.1",          # from 0.9
  "effective_from": "2026-07-15",
  "effective_to": "2026-09-30"
}
```
This is aimed at incentivizing SIs to prioritize Redwood integrations during the delayed promo window.

Marco: Ops ok with the logic, but we need legal sign-off for any tier/contract changes that alter partner commitments. Also flag: metric reporting needs to reflect temporary multipliers.

Sam: I'll route the spend rework and updated forecast to Legal and Finance execs. Nina, looping you in. I can have a provisional spend sheet by tomorrow 10am PT.

Nina (legal): Noted. Contract addenda may be required for partners that were promised marketplace placement. I need the list of affected partner IDs and the proposed communication text. Will review draft within 48 hours.

Ava: Quick impact sim (high level): increasing SI multiplier to 1.1 + $70k enablement yields an estimated uplift of ~$450k qualified pipeline over 6 months (model posted to #partnerships-data). This is backend-estimated and assumes 35% conversion to opportunity.

Priya: Decision checklist for moving forward:
- Finance sign-off on reallocation (Sam)
- Legal confirmation on contract/communication (Nina)
- Partner Council informal vote
If we get all by Fri 5pm PT I’ll trigger the MDF Bot to issue POs and update the partner portal.

Voting (quick reactions):
- Marco: +1
- Sam: +1 (conditional on contingency being trimmed)
- Lena: +1
- Nina: +0 (waiting on draft)
- Ava: +1

Priya: If no objections by Fri 5pm PT I’ll proceed with the change and post the official partner comms template.

Marco: Will escalate in ops sync and flag the two pending partner POs that might need priority.

Sam: I’ll prepare the spend sheet and updated forecast by tomorrow morning and attach partner IDs.

Ava: I’ll upload the SI enablement schedule and proposed training curriculum to the ticket and cross-post to #partner-enablement.

Priya: Thanks all — appreciate quick turnaround on this one. I’ll draft the partner comms and the scorecard change PR once I have finance + legal approvals. :pray:
